issue_request: FHIR-54804 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 Imaging Integration change request for ImagingSelection WADO-RS text. It asked that the response media type sentence make clear that Accept identifies the user agent's preferred media type by moving "preferred" before "media type", removing the old parenthetical, and removing the semicolon.

The Confluence endpoint notes referenced by the Jira list FHIR-54804 and FHIR-54805 in the same Jan2026_II_Endpoint ImagingSelection group; FHIR-54805 concerns the example GET request and was not decided here. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
